facts.fact: Senegal's CDP, headed by president Ousmane Thiongane, acted as the supervisory body, saying the state's CCTV extension had its prior approval.
facts.system: Commission de protection des donnees personnelles (CDP)

facts.fact: The CDP president said the Interior Ministry's CCTV system for the Youth Olympic Games complies with the law, which requires a CDP receipt before cameras are installed.
The CDP president said the Interior Ministry submitted Dakar's street cameras for CDP authorisation in 2015 and followed the same process for the 2026 extension.
